en.t: Is that not putting it a little too sensuously?"

units.source_text: 写在一张陆奥纸上，书体十分古雅，笔法饶有趣致。

en.t: It was written on a sheet of Michinoku paper; the script was very antique and elegant, and the brushwork had a charming interest.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，觉得异常风流，甚是吃惊。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw it, he found it extraordinarily refined and was greatly astonished.

units.source_text: 明石道人犒赏使者的是一件特别精致的女衫。

en.t: What the Akashi monk gave the messenger as a reward was an especially exquisite woman's robe.
